The e2b is Google's effective-2B Gemma 4, so nano; most STACK-style agents ask for small or above and must pin it. Seen on LM Studio (2026-11-09): native tool calling, streaming (thinking arrives as it is produced), image input (one solid-colour PNG read correctly), and thinking on by default, which reasoning_effort none switches off (the other levels are accepted; whether they differ was not measured). structured_output is none because inferenceswitch sends json_object to LM Studio, which answers 400 (#25); LM Studio does accept json_schema, so this moves up when that is fixed. No Ollama route: its tag was not checked.

Z.ai's flagship (753B, 40B active). Large by parameters, mid by benchmark: 31.7 on the Artificial Analysis index against Haiku 5.5's 36.5, so placed on the benchmark. Text only. Thinking on by default.
Lower end of mid: 27.8 on the Artificial Analysis index, level with GPT-6 Luna (27.9). Z.ai's small step; the same family as glm-5.3 at under a tenth of the price.
Mid: 29.1 on the Artificial Analysis index. MiniMax community licence, which has conditions on commercial use; check it before relying on the weights.
Lower end of mid: 26.7 on the Artificial Analysis index, one point above the mid edge. MIT licence.
Mid: 29.9 on the Artificial Analysis index, near its Flash sibling; not a rung above despite 1T parameters. MIT licence.

Mid, candidate for large, because the two views split: 46.5 on the Artificial Analysis index is above GPT-6 Sol (44.2, large), while 161.4 on the Epoch Capabilities Index [159.0, 164.0] is level with Haiku 5.5 (160.4) and GPT-5.6 Terra (160.7), with the large edge (163) inside its interval. Placed on the lower under the under-claim rule; it is the strongest open-weight card here and priced like Sonnet 5.5. 2.8T parameters, 104B active. Kimi K3.1-Pro licence.

Mid. The September 2026 release; the 1017 revision (deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017) scores higher and is the one to prefer. Artificial Analysis has no index for this one, so the rung rests on its HLE (39.2), a little under the 1017 revision's 43.3.
Mid: 32.6 on the Artificial Analysis index at max effort, level with GPT-5.6 Terra (32.3). The October 2026 revision of deepseek-v4.1-flash. MIT licence.
Lower end of mid: 28.6 on the Artificial Analysis index. Qwen Community Licence. Artificial Analysis lists a 256K window and OpenRouter 1M; the smaller is recorded.

Mid, candidate for large: no index from Artificial Analysis, and its HLE (42.4) sits among the mid anchors (Haiku 5.5 44.4, GPT-5.6 Terra 42.9). 2.4T parameters, 95B active, priced like a large model. Qwen3.8-Max licence.
Small: HLE 22.2 and no index, against 18.8 for Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. 3B active parameters. Apache 2.0.
Small, though a dense 27B starts at mid by size: HLE 23.1 and no index, level with its MoE sibling qwen3.6-35b-a3b. Apache 2.0.
Small. A dense 9B; HLE 14.9. Apache 2.0.

Small, though 30B total starts at mid: 3B active parameters and an April 2025 generation. GPQA Diamond (51.5) is close to qwen3-32b's (53.5), so mid is arguable; placed lower under the under-claim rule. Thinking is on or off only (the /think and /no_think switches, or enable_thinking), with no graded effort, so reasoning_effort is not offered. Reachable from vLLM too, by adding a ProviderSpec for the server.
Small: 5.5 on the Artificial Analysis index, below its resolution, so placed by size (31.6B total, 3.6B active) and HLE (10.6). OpenMDW licence.
